names: João Crisóstomo de Abreu e Sousa
summary: João Crisóstomo de Abreu e Sousa (1811–1895) was an army engineer and politician who was President of the Council of Ministers of Portugal from 1890 to 1892, at the head of a government drawn from no single party in the years after the British Ultimatum. He is in the atlas as the holder of that turn at the headship of the government.
